inputScope: Exact final integration package.json/package-lock.json and installed node_modules; read-only inspection. No all-source validation or legal readiness claim.

method.addedSet: 46 direct devDependencies minus explicit 19 prior-stage toolchain/foundation/CDK names listed here; independently reconstructed 27 current direct roots.
method.packageResolution: Nearest package.json in node_modules while walking parent directories, scoped/nested instances preserved; never outside this input.
method.closure: dependencies + optionalDependencies + peerDependencies; never package devDependencies. Missing optional/platform entries kept as edges.
method.boundary: Direct 25 runtime engine declarations, 1 ambient type package, 1 test decoder; type and native Node-only nodes marked separately. Declared closure is not asserted to all execute in a browser.
method.licenseCopies: Original bytes of license/notice/copying/copyright/authors files found in each instance, recursively excluding its nested node_modules. Additional embedded attributions inspected explicitly.
method.distribution: Installed asset/source SHA compared to existing dist; two paired ESM entries and all split chunks read without rebundling. No bundle added-byte claim.
